independentReviews.finding: Conditional inline create(...) supplied a resolved returned-function candidate.
independentReviews.mainDisposition: Not an implementation defect under the current source-control contract: an inline candidate retains its exact original branch/try path, whereas a conditional assigned result still has an unmodeled binding. Main added source-to-native skipped-branch and relocated-creation counterexamples; no global dominance gate was added.

mainVerification.redEvidence: Initial eight regressions failed on missing actual returned value/proof. Corrected order regression retained the caller rebinding writer and failed with the old order fact; using callableOrder rejects moving creation after that writer.
mainVerification.discardedFixtureEvidence: The first rebinding-order red fixture pruned its dead scalar writer and lacked a writer-presence assertion; it is not evidence of the implementation defect. Main corrected the fixture before the decisive red/green check.
mainVerification.controlCounterexamples: Original if/try creation is adopted only in its source region; relocation removes consume adoption. A literal-false inline branch executes no returned callable and reaches the later effect, retaining the existing unknown operation-exception diagnostic.

sourceSignature: Actual returned/callback calls use original source parameters; captured parameters are bound from the actual function object, with no caller capture reconstruction or synthetic instance argument.
